blurb: Wollman Rink is an ice skating rink located near the southeast corner of Central Park, NYC. Guests can enjoy public skating, private lessons with professional coaches, group skating discounts, and special events. The rink operates seasonally from October through March and offers skate rentals and a café onsite.
extraNote: Tickets are non-refundable · No re-entry once you leave the facility · If canceled due to unsafe weather, guests can reschedule · Wollman Rink box office near 59th Street and 6th Avenue entrance to Central Park
